phase_2_pinning.scope: Phase 2, task 1: the workspace pin shared by the implementation dispatch plan and the retained overlay binding. Unit, dispatch and temporary-repository tests; no worker job selects a projected workspace, and no authority provider or restricted runtime is involved.
phase_2_pinning.immediate_outcome: A dispatch plan can pin the admitted repository, exact source revision, definition, manifest, materializer profile, input and overlay generation for its attempt and fence. Admission refuses a pin for another attempt, fence or base, an inconsistent overlay and a workspace that is not that overlay; the plan identity includes the pin, while a plan without one keeps its frozen identity. The worker prepares or resumes an overlay only for the exact pin its plan derives and its v2 binding records.
phase_2_pinning.durable_capability: kiln_core::projection::materialization (WorkspacePin, MaterializationPlan::pin, MaterializerProfile::identity, overlay_identity), DispatchWorkspace.projection with admit_dispatch_plan, and kiln_web_service::worker::materialize::prepare_overlay with the kiln.materialization.binding.v2 overlay binding.
phase_2_pinning.ordering: The proposal, design and tasks gates passed again after the contract was extended and before the code changed; the frozen unpinned plan identity was captured from the code before the change.
